description: DC Water publishes this infrastructure inventory through its open data portal. The hydrant dataset contains locations and status information for approximately 9,500 DC Water-owned hydrants across the District of Columbia. The provider updates it daily and describes a map and CSV download. The asset locations support representations of water-system access points and emergency-response planning. The source explains that hydrant appearance or colour does not determine available fire flow, so this inventory does not establish hydraulic capacity. Access to the public display is free. The provider limits use to public information about the programme and excludes commercial, legal or other use; no standard open licence is stated. Caveats include historical and contractor-supplied records, no accuracy guarantee and possible changes to the display. The CSV files and embedded maps were not queried. Related record data-dc-water-sanitary-sewer-overflow-dashboard describes a separate wastewater event collection.
